name: PROTOCOL AI PAIRS
scope: All one readable SQF reviewed. Binary config/startup, dependencies and licensing remain unverified; no source copied into product.

contributions.intent: A moving buddy is supported by the other, then roles alternate.
contributions.source: Consecutive roster pairs toggle _leapFrog on the first actor; one doMove and one doSuppressiveFire per iteration.
contributions.cbe: CombatPairs retains eligible buddy identity; CombatPairElements allocates partners to opposite move/cover roles. CortexAdvanceStart commits synchronised buddy bounds through OperationStart, and CortexFlankStep owns physical arrival, finite recovery and role alternation.

contributions.intent: Keep a partner when casualties occur.
contributions.source: Every iteration rebuilds consecutive alive roster pairs; no persistent identity or orphan repair and an odd actor gets no work.
contributions.cbe: CombatPairs preserves intact eligible pairs and repairs orphans by nearest eligible3D partner; CombatPairsPublish retains out-of-scope living identity. RebalanceRoles repairs active participants under current generation/epoch and native-task guards.

contributions.intent: Move toward the fight while supporting fire remains available.
contributions.source: Random15..25m zigzag toward a current live enemy transform, without terrain/path/fire-lane checks or route ownership.
contributions.cbe: Finite authored/believed routes, actor admission, physical progress, original deadlines, screened avenues and native-order receipts. Suppression is separate owner-local fire control with ammunition, policy and protected-lane checks.

rejectedMechanics: Endless allGroups loop with no sleep/interval; repeated native orders and group COMBAT writes even before enemy check.
No locality/player/Zeus/medical/ROE/external-owner guards; direct hidden live target position reads.
Unleased UP/MIDDLE stance and FULL speed writes with no restoration; role turn toggles per scan rather than after actual arrival or covering fire.
concreteFix: RebalanceRoles now excludes queued medical healers before recruitment/retention and rechecks that same eligibility at publication; it does not clear queues or drop shared living pair identity.
remainingRequiredWork: Confirm physical opposite buddy roles, covering fire, actual bound arrival, interrupted orders, odd-size groups, casualty replacement and normal/HC owner transfer when audits resume. Code integration is not functional acceptance.

Independent pair-granular timing is an optional CBE enhancement, currently unimplemented. The source flips per-pair flags on each global scan without arrival-driven waves; this optional extension is not required to reproduce its useful paired move/cover intent.
Binary registration/dependency declarations were reviewed in protocol-binary-configuration-20261021.json; runtime dependencies and source licensing remain separate from behaviour integration.

outdoorPairComposition.implementation: Read-only CombatElementSelect shared by advance/flank/assault starts prefers intact persistent pairs in ranked eligible candidates, then orphans. Minimum mover strength may override cohesion. Existing specialist, ammunition, cover-capacity and order gates remain authoritative.
outdoorPairComposition.bounds: Top16 ranked candidates,16 pair rows,max5movers; no world query/new worker/publication. Callers shortlist rather than rejecting larger groups.
limitations: First advance/assault operation pairing now follows committed elements via initialElementPairing; physical flow remains unverified.
Independent per-pair leapfrogging is not implemented. Later casualty replacement can still split pairs when tactical capacity requires it.
Runtime flow, balance, actual covering fire and performance remain unmeasured.
outdoorPairComposition.validation: 607 focused/full1477 existing tests; HEMTT/SQF/FSM/docs/package and independent candidate verification passed. Initial coverage failure fixed by existing ADVANCE source registration/report regeneration; no acceptance scores changed.

initialElementPairing.gap: OperationStart originally generated nearest pairs across the whole advance/assault roster after mover/cover selection; fresh pairs could cross element boundaries.
initialElementPairing.change: OperationStart optional element partition is validated for disjoint membership and full requested-roster coverage before previous operation cancellation. Within live capable participants, CombatPairs calculates per-element rows without publication; combined registry published once. Advance and assault supply actual mover/cover arrays. Ordinary callers retain default behaviour.
initialElementPairing.limits: Metadata composition only; no independent per-pair executor. Later casualty/replacement/minimum-capacity needs can still split pairs. Individual CombatPairs16actor bounds retained; no broad scalability/physical claim.
initialElementPairing.validation: 607 focused/full1477 existing tests; HEMTT/SQF/FSM/docs/package and independent verification pass.

pairLifecyclePartitions.finding: RebalanceRoles and drill owner resumption could rebuild orphan pairs across existing mover/cover team boundaries.
pairLifecyclePartitions.implementation: OperationStart records pairElements. RebalanceRoles uses current matching drill generation/epoch and disjoint complete team partition for dry per-element pair repair, one combined publication. It reacts to partition changes even with unchanged participants and avoids unchanged publication. CortexDrillResume supplies its filtered team partition to normal OperationStart admission.
pairLifecyclePartitions.authority: No new movement owner, native command, worker or deadline. Recruitment remains separate from physical progress; source/current generation/epoch and participant-task commit guards remain.
pairLifecyclePartitions.limits: Minimum role/fire capacity may split pairs, independent per-pair leapfrogging incomplete. Malformed/incomplete resume partition is refused by shared operation admission. Runtime flow and performance unverified.
pairLifecyclePartitions.validation: 607 focused/full1477 existing tests, HEMTT/SQF/FSM/docs/package and independent verification passed.

twoActorAdvanceAdmission.implementation: Exactly two available armed foot actors may start existing ADVANCE drill as 1+1. Persistent pairing spans mover/cover roles instead of singleton element partitions. Ordinary route bounds clamp to20m through actual shared route planner; road crossings remain continuous. Existing finite FSM, physical arrival, ammunition and current task/order checks retain role authority.
twoActorAdvanceAdmission.limits: Successive buddy bounding only; independent pair-granular leapfrog within larger squads remains incomplete. No physical fire/arrival/balance/performance evidence; audits paused.
twoActorAdvanceAdmission.validation: 1478 existing tests/full HEMTT build passed; existing assertions extended, no new tests.

smallElementFlow.implementation: Three available armed actors with two suitable movers may start2+1 ADVANCE; ordinary bounds capped20m. Existing movingMinimum recognises arrived2+singleton-follow for ordinary and coordinated drills, avoiding a needless relief transfer. Two-capable-actor ADVANCE resume preserves one buddy identity across singleton roles.
smallElementFlow.limits: Initial specialist-role suitability remains authoritative. No per-pair leapfrog executor for larger squads. Physical flow, casualties, migration, cover fire and overhead unverified; audits paused.
smallElementFlow.validation: 1478 existing tests, HEMTT/full build passed; existing assertions extended.

untouchedPartnerRetention.finding: Publication discarded a complete previous row when any member had a new active assignment, losing untouched living same-group partners from the registry.
untouchedPartnerRetention.implementation: Filter already assigned actors individually from valid prior rows; retain remaining actors as singleton rows. Active assignments win, unique membership and sixteen-row bound remain.
untouchedPartnerRetention.limits: Metadata only. No recruitment, movement, independent pair executor or fitness authority. Physical casualty flow and overhead unverified; audits paused.
untouchedPartnerRetention.validation: Existing pair-publication regression extended with reassignment and singleton cases; full build result recorded in handover.

pairAwareReserveRefill.finding: CortexFlankStep refill selected individual ranked reserves even when two vacancies could accept an intact reserve buddy pair. Donor transfer and initial admission were pair-aware but reserve refill was not.
pairAwareReserveRefill.implementation: Reuse CombatElementSelect for existing non-team and team refill loops: up to five vacancies, top sixteen eligible ranked candidates, remove selected batch before next team. Preserve outer team index for replacement history.
pairAwareReserveRefill.authority: Same existing private proposal and exact drill/native/operation/epoch commit boundary. No new command, worker, world query, lifetime or attempt.
pairAwareReserveRefill.limits: Minimum capacity or a single vacancy can split a pair; shortlist and registry bounds remain. Existing buddy already assigned to a team receives no special candidate priority. Independent per-pair leapfrog and physical flow remain incomplete.
pairAwareReserveRefill.validation: Existing casualty ownership regression extended; complete build result in handover.

receivingTeamReunion.finding: Pair-aware reserve refill ignored a candidate whose recorded buddy already belonged to the receiving team, so unrelated intact reserve pairs could take vacancies first.
receivingTeamReunion.implementation: CombatElementSelect optional receiving-team identities, bounded16 and disjoint from ranked candidates. Ranked eligible partners of those identities are selected first, removed from remaining candidate pool, then existing intact-pair/orphan/minimum selection runs. Both refill paths supply their current receiving team shortlist; initial callers default empty.
receivingTeamReunion.authority: Identity preference only; candidate qualification and exact final owner/task/native commit remain. No movement, publication, query, worker or deadline.
receivingTeamReunion.cost: Additional bounded candidate-by-registry membership pass when receiving team is nonempty, max16x16 pair rows; runtime unmeasured.
receivingTeamReunion.limits: Receiving team and candidate shortlist16; historical identity must still be present. Does not restore overwritten old relationships, promise physical reunion or supply independent pair-level alternation.
receivingTeamReunion.validation: Existing source-contract checks extended; full build result in handover.

reliefFireCapacity.finding: Buddy-aware donor relief retained headcount but could transfer every ammunition-qualified rifle in an intact pair, leaving dry or hold-fire actors as nominal cover. A dry orphan could also be preferred despite not repairing mover fire capacity.
reliefFireCapacity.implementation: When actual relief is requested and donor headcount permits, qualify current YELLOW/RED, FIREWEAPON and primary main-muzzle ammo/reserve availability. Prefer armed orphan, then intact pair only if a qualified rifle remains, then one qualified rifle. Require at least two qualified donor rifles before transfer. Recovery loop exits immediately on no feasible transfer; existing finite failure path remains.
reliefFireCapacity.authority: Read-only selection; existing fit/task/native/owner/epoch roster commit and next-bound fire checks remain. No fire command, reload, inventory mutation, worker or deadline.
reliefFireCapacity.cost: New bounded current donor ammunition checks only for depleted-role relief, loaded main-muzzle fast path. No routine every-movement-sample poll; runtime unmeasured.
reliefFireCapacity.limits: Ammo/permission is not immediate readiness, covering-fire effect or balanced independent pair-level execution. Dry actors remain physical participants; insufficient global firepower may still end the drill. Physical casualty/recovery flow unverified.
reliefFireCapacity.validation: All1482/full HEMTT/SQF/config/FSM/docs/package passed in .qa/relief-fire-capacity-final-build.log. Initial overly broad pre-issue ammo assertion narrowed to reject routine polling outside relief helper; finite empty-relief refusal checked. Independent candidate fingerprint fb908ccaf51695adc33a628bf77e19a6656dd4d69e8f4c156f7ffbe272916bd4.
reliefFireCapacity.exitExemption: CROSS_FAR/CONSOLIDATE retain donor headcount/pair selection without ammo/ROE qualification, matching existing next-bound exemption so dry actors can leave danger.

reserveRecruitFireCapacity.finding: Reserve refill could select dry/hold-fire/FIREWEAPON-disabled newcomers before the next-bound capacity check, replacing a casualty numerically without repairing tactical fire capacity. Reserve task/role ranking also ran when no vacancy existed.
reserveRecruitFireCapacity.implementation: Filter new ordinary-leg reserve candidates with the same primary ammo, individual YELLOW/RED and FIREWEAPON policy before shared pair selection. Existing participants stay enrolled. CROSS_FAR/CONSOLIDATE preserve movement-only recruitment. Rank candidates only if single element or any team is below desired count.
reserveRecruitFireCapacity.authority: Existing queued care, protected native tasks, reservations, locality, ownership and final roster commit unchanged. No forced reload, inventory edit, new worker, movement writer or deadline.
reserveRecruitFireCapacity.cost: No reserve ranking/task/role/ammo work on intact-roster callbacks; actual vacancies add main-muzzle ammo qualification with loaded-round fast path. Physical cost not measured.
reserveRecruitFireCapacity.limits: Available ammo/permission is not effective cover or instant readiness. No global firepower guarantee or independent pair-level executor. Dry existing actors can still finish current movement and use normal sharing/rearm paths.
reserveRecruitFireCapacity.validation: Existing48 focused reservation tests passed; existing no-routine-inventory-poll assertion updated to restrict ammo checks to vacancy/relief helpers. Full build result in handover.

preferredBoundSlotCohesion.implementation: Read current shared pair registry at issue, keep eligible existing buddies adjacent before slot geometry, and preserve the exact selected roster. Bound to sixteen movers and sixteen pair rows; larger elements retain their order.

preferredBoundSlotCohesion.limits: Preferred slot adjacency is not a physical spacing guarantee. Current executor still alternates fire teams; independent pair-level leapfrogging remains unfinished.

recoveryCoverAdmission.finding: FlankStep removes recovery actors before constructing _fit, so two-team cover excludes them. Its no-team _issue branch instead queried _fitSquad minus movers, allowing an armed separated recovery actor to be the only covering-capacity witness.
recoveryCoverAdmission.implementation: Subtract current recovery actors from the single-element wider-squad cover pool. Preserve available unassigned cover and existing fire permission/ammo checks, exit/consolidation exemptions, recovery movement and original deadlines.
recoveryCoverAdmission.cost: One existing-roster array subtraction at next-bound issue; no world query, polling job, timer or native command.

pairExecutionTrace.scope: Current CortexFlankStep execution inspected 2026-10-21; independent pair-level execution remains incomplete.
pairExecutionTrace.selection: _ensureMovingTeam assumes exactly two roles via otherTurn=1-turn; recruitment/relief and actor admission run before each issue.
pairExecutionTrace.arrival: MOVE observes actor-specific spots/progress/retries, then a 60-percent role quorum with finite six-second progress grace can mark remaining actors as recovery. It does not record independent pair wave arrival.
pairExecutionTrace.transition: First team arrival enters PAUSE; PAUSE flips teamTurn 0 to1. Only second-team completion advances the route point. boundDeadlineIdentity is [point index,teamTurn].
pairExecutionTrace.recovery: Recovery prefers a real surviving buddy in the same element, with one finite route attempt. Physically rejoined actors return only outside MOVE. Recorded resume spots, progress and retries are actor-addressed.
pairExecutionTrace.requiredDeparture: Only if independently timed CBE pair waves are selected as a further enhancement: preserve distinct wave identity/arrivals under the parent deadline, coherent cover selection and casualty recovery. Do not replace binary teamTurn with arbitrary pair indices. This is not an existing source arrival-driven feature.
pairExecutionTrace.limits: This trace proves code structure, not actual covering fire, native path quality, pair timing or source parity.

pairExecutionReconciliation.sourceSemantics: One actor per consecutive pair moves while its partner receives suppression; turn flips every unslept global scan without physical arrival. No finite independent-wave arrival lifecycle exists in source.
pairExecutionReconciliation.currentCBE: AdvanceStart armed two-actor admission uses minimum1 mover/1 cover and bounds<=20m; FlankStep small-survivor rebalance preserves opposite roles, actual actor spots/progress, finite grace/recovery and binary team handoff. Larger groups use pair-preserving fire-team allocation.
pairExecutionReconciliation.disposition: Two-person arrival-controlled alternation already has an integrated executor; not a missing parallel controller. Larger-group pair-granular alternation remains a distinct unimplemented capability. Do not replace binary teamTurn with arbitrary pair indices or claim full parity from two-actor support.
pairExecutionReconciliation.nextAction: Validate current synchronised opposite roles and actual cover/arrival/casualty flow when audits are authorised. Independent pair timing is optional further build-out, not a missing source feature or a prerequisite added to the current implementation batch.

New replacements with retained incumbents check at most5 local formation slots against terrain/all saved destinations before one existing cover query; no usable slot ends NO_REPLACEMENT_SPACE before movement writes. Existing ownership checks remain. Actual path/cover/performance unverified; not independent pair-wave parity.
